page_title: ATA 2-3 PAR | Atalanta v Parma 25/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' The Atalanta players are exchanging some short passes.

90+1' 2 - 3 Goal! Adrian Bernabe Garcia passes the ball to Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Marco Carnesecchi couldn't do anything about it. 2:3.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Livio Marinelli shows a yellow card to Botond Balogh (Parma), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

89' Marco Carnesecchi was forced into action to thwart Jacob Ondrejka (Parma). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
88' Ange-Yoan Bonny goes off the pitch and Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) comes on.
87' Parma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
83' Stefan Posch (Atalanta) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Parma win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
82' Parma are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
79' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Parma.

79' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent. The ball goes behind for a corner. Parma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
78' The substitution has been made. Nahuel Estevez (Parma) has replaced Simon Sohm.

77' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom right corner. However, he couldn't beat Marco Carnesecchi, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
77' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 11:10.
76' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is adjudged offside.
72' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) replaces Raoul Bellanova.

71' 2 - 2 Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Marco Carnesecchi is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 2:2.
68' A corner kick by Atalanta is thwarted by the well prepared Zion Suzuki (Parma).

67' The most active player in today's match is definitely Mateo Retegui (Atalanta). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
64' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
61' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
61' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
58' Today's match ends for Ibrahim Sulemana who will be replaced by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta).
57' Corner kick. Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) is ready to send the ball into the box.
57' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Simon Sohm (Parma). Parma force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
57' The Atalanta players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
55' The referee allows time for a substitution. Marco Brescianini will be replaced by Ederson (Atalanta).
53' Antoine Hainaut (Parma) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
53' The linesman raises his flag. Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) is adjudged offside.

52' Golden chance! Ibrahim Sulemana (Atalanta) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
51' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
51' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
49' 2 - 1 Antoine Hainaut (Parma) struck from medium range. He buried the ball inside the right post.
49' Antoine Hainaut (Parma) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
47' A yellow card for a tackle by Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta). Livio Marinelli doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
46' Half-time substitution. Christian Chivu decided to make a change. Emanuele Valeri (Parma) is replaced by Antoine Hainaut.
46' Christian Chivu has made a change at the break. Jacob Ondrejka has come on in place of Hernani (Parma).
46' Half-time substitution. Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) is replaced by Ademola Lookman.
46' Gian Piero Gasperini makes a half-time substitution. Stefan Posch comes on in place of Marco Palestra (Atalanta).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Simon Sohm (Parma) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
45' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
42' Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

42' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Zion Suzuki pulls off an easy save. It will be a corner kick for Atalanta.
41' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

40' Parma slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
38' Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
37' PENALTY APPEAL after Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

36' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
33' 2 - 0 Goal! Mateo Retegui tees up Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the right side of the goal. 2:0.
32' 1 - 0 Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home inside the right post. The goalkeeper was helpless.
32' Hernani (Parma) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
29' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Zion Suzuki.
27' Hernani (Parma) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
26' The total number of attempts is 2:4.
25' Marco Carnesecchi stretches to his left and makes a brilliant save! Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper inside the right post.

23' Botond Balogh (Parma) comes close to scoring. He meets a lovely lofted pass from Hernani, but sends his close-range header way over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
17' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Emanuele Valeri (Parma).

15' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.

12' Great solo effort by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the right side of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save.
10' Simon Sohm (Parma) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Marco Carnesecchi comes off the line to clear the ball away.
9' Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
8' Christian Chivu is forced to make a change. Mandela Keita is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma).
8' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
7' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Atalanta.
5' Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

5' Marco Palestra (Atalanta) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort towards the right side of the goal and Zion Suzuki easily plucks the ball out of the air. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick.
4' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
2' Parma enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Atalanta will kick-off.
Livio Marinelli was nominated as the referee for this game.
